name: caret
title: Caret
description: The mark at the end of text that is still being written.
use: After the last word of an answer as it streams, or after a prompt that waits for input. It is decoration: hide it with aria-hidden, mark the region that is being written with aria-busy, and remove the caret when the text is complete.

instead.when: Nothing is written yet and the words say work is under way
Another person is typing in a conversation
The wait belongs to a control

classes.name: caret
classes.description: A fine upright bar in the ink of the words it follows, as tall as their letters, that fades out and back about once a second

classes.name: caret-block
classes.description: A terminal's caret: half an em wide

example: The column is added as nullable first
